Usage Terms Summary for the dataset ‘Experiences of migrant and intercultural couples with marriage preparation, faith and spirituality, church community and integration into the Netherlands’.

Access to the restricted files is granted under the following conditions:
  1. The data must be used exclusively for non-commercial academic research or ecclesial purposes.
  2. Users must uphold the highest ethical standards, particularly given the sensitive nature of the content (data from migrant couples and intercultural couples).
  3. The data must not be shared with others. Access is granted for individual use only.
  4. Users agree to take full responsibility for protecting the dignity and rights of the individuals represented in the data.
  5. Use of the data must comply with relevant data protection laws and institutional ethical guidelines.
  6. Users must cite the following publication in any outputs, publications, or presentations resulting from use of the dataset: tba.
By requesting access, users confirm that they have read and agreed to these conditions. Access requests from users affiliated with educational institutions may be approved directly. Other requests will be reviewed on a case-by-case basis.

fields.value: Experiences of migrant and intercultural couples with marriage preparation, faith and spirituality, church community and integration into the Netherlands

datasetContactAffiliation.value: Tilburg University, Tilburg School of Catholic Theology

dsDescriptionValue.value: Results from survey among migrant and intercultural couples (n = 223) on experiences with marriage preparation, faith and spirituality, church community and integration into the Netherlands. Main research question: To what extent can Marriage and Relationship Education (MRE) and pastoral accompaniment before and after marriage within the Catholic Church contribute to a higher relationship quality among migrant and intercultural couples in the Netherlands?

publicationCitation.value: Biemans, W., ‘Marriage preparation, pastoral accompaniment, and relationship quality among migrant and intercultural couples in the Netherlands’, Family Forum 13, 2023, 153–171.

fields.value:
Ethical clearance by by Ethical Review Board TST, ID-code: ERB-TST # 2020/7
Universe: Migrant couples and intercultural couples of various nationalities, married between 1995 and 2021 in the Catholic Church, living in the Netherlands.
